title: 2.8 Basic Colors
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Recognize, hear and say six colors on objects the learner already knows, and describe one thing with It is and several with They are.
grammar_function: Color adjectives; It is + color for one thing; They are + color for several.
prerequisite: 1.3 they are; 2.1 it is; 2.2-2.3 bus, bike, car, chair, bag, table; 2.6-2.7 counting photos.
speaking_outcome: Name the color of a known object with It is or They are.
